product.schneider-n38616-80.summary: The N386/16 with a 80 MB disk.
product.schneider-n38616-80.history: The German offer of December 1991 listed the 80 MB N386/16 notebook at DM 6,132 net and included MS-DOS 5.0 and G-BASIC.
product.schneider-n38616-80.technical.co: The sales list specifies a 640 × 480 VGA display and 256 KB of video memory.
product.schneider-n38616-80.technical.ve: The commercial offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-n38616-80.technical.li: The board still needs identification and an attributed BIOS needs preservation. An image with clear publication rights remains pending.
product.schneider-n38616-80.technical.pr: CC SELLER / BC, Schneider Computer, 12/1991, pp. 1–2
